integrity.claim_scope: all continuous F homotopic to T_m for degree/impossibility, fixed explicit linear F and small C1 perturbations for positive embedding
integrity.critical_evidence: integral H1 cup-product determinant; elementary row reduction; invariance of domain; covering degree; Smith form
integrity.numerical_status: supplemental exact symbolic checks only, not universal proof

scientific_limitations: Exactly three consecutive forward circle-valued delays; longer/nonconsecutive delay embeddings unclassified.
The positive nonlinear perturbation theorem is local in C1 around the indicated toral endomorphism.
Optimal finite fiber count is for integer Fourier characters of unperturbed maps; degree alone does not bound all nonlinear zero-degree fiber sizes.
title: Arithmetic degree obstruction and robust three-delay reconstruction for exact toral maps
